admission.justification: Overwriting a user's hand-made role choices is a costly, silent loss; the cases keep an existing file byte for byte and refuse to complete missing choices.

applicability: Initializing the single user settings file when its destination already exists.
conditions: The existing file is read and reported, and its bytes and permissions stay as they were.
Roles absent from the existing file are not filled in silently.
exclusions: An absent destination, which the initializer creates.
The whole-file migration that upgrades an older settings shape.

evidence: a2/native-review.md N4; final-a3/source-witnesses.md; new tests explicitly expect host-only completion.

statement: Settings initialization reads every pre-existing destination without overwriting, merging, changing permissions or silently completing choices.
